states.INITIALIZING: Process bootstrap; checking snapshot or awaiting initial data.
states.WARMING_UP: Accumulating closed candles; window lookback < 288 bars.
states.FULL_WINDOW_READY: Contiguous window >= 288 bars; pre-flight eligibility checks active.
states.STALE_DATA: Data staleness detected; time since last closed candle exceeds 600s.
states.SOURCE_GAP: Gap detected in sequence (> 300s); continuity broken; buffer purged.
states.INVALID_CANDLE: Candle geometry or negative volume validation failure.
states.CLOCK_UNTRUSTED: Local clock drift against exchange or NTP exceeds 1,000 ms.
states.SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT: Saved snapshot checksum mismatch or JSON syntax corruption.
states.PAUSED: Operator or safety trigger has paused prediction generation.
states.ELIGIBLE: All quality and timing gates passed; eligible for prospective prediction scoring.

fail_closed_rules: Predictions generated in any state other than ELIGIBLE are strictly non-prospective.
SOURCE_GAP and INVALID_CANDLE force a buffer purge and restart in WARMING_UP.
CLOCK_UNTRUSTED prevents transition to ELIGIBLE until clock skew returns to <= 1000 ms.
